subject: The 30-second date rule
preview_text: One tiny trick that doubles your date nights without planning fatigue.
body_paragraphs: You know that moment when you're both scrolling Netflix, hungry, and someone sighs 'what should we do?' That's the spark killer. But here's a 30-second trick that flips it: pick one mood before you pick a plan. Just one word—cozy, adventurous, playful, healing—and suddenly the decision shrinks from overwhelming to obvious.

It works because your brain hates open-ended choices. When you name the mood first, you're not planning a date; you're just saying how you want to feel. Couples who do this in the first 24 hours plan 4x more dates the next month. Not because they try harder—because they stop trying to be creative and start being intentional.

Inside SoulPlan, that's exactly what Tonight's Date does. Tap a mood on your home screen, and the AI serves you one perfect plan in 30 seconds. No scrolling, no fighting over options. Just a single card that says 'this is us tonight.' Your partner gets a full-screen 'thought of you' moment, and you both skip the planning guilt.

Open the app now, tap any mood on Tonight's Date, and feel how light a date can be when the decision weight is lifted. P.S. That mood you pick tonight becomes a memory in your timeline—proof that the spark isn't on the to-do list, it's in the tap.
